goals.title: Create the new repository and reproducible runtime source unit
goals.result: A new repository has a repeatable toolchain and an identifiable dsh artifact; a developer can start the first product slice without guessing versions.
steps: Create sophia-next as a separate repository; preserve the existing app and outstanding obligations.
Check out the exact dsh pin outside the product tree. Record Node 24 exact version and pnpm 11.7.0; resolve and commit ordinary application dependencies.
Create the workspace packages and bundle exports. Produce a pinned runtime artifact and bundle archive; record their digests.
Install the named profile manifest from the verified declaration types. Run the trusted configuration dump and retain startup diagnostics.
acceptance: A clean second checkout resolves the same lock and artifact identities.
The profile includes dsh-base and the Sophia bundle, not another root loop.
The document source map and code destination map are committed, with unbuilt paths still labelled.
adverse_checks: A missing/incompatible Sophia bundle does not become a healthy runtime.
A comments-only or wrong-row patch is diagnosed rather than silently accepted as the intended configuration.

goals.title: Admit a project command and replay its state in the UI
goals.result: Two authenticated members see the same project and a durable admitted action; reconnect does not duplicate or lose it.
steps: Implement the first schema slice: project/member, command, event and job/outbox records. Write explicit migrations and access tests before wiring clients.
Implement authentication, server-derived actor identity, expected-revision admission and transactional outbox.
Implement a current snapshot plus sequence-based SSE replay; render the admitted work in a minimal real Studio view.
Use the contract examples as fixtures, not native evidence. Extend typed schemas into generated clients as the implementation lands.
acceptance: Both real member sessions can access the shared project; a different account cannot.
Same request/payload returns the same command; different payload under the same key conflicts.
A disconnect between commit and acknowledgement recovers the existing result.
adverse_checks: A stale expected revision cannot overwrite a newer accepted change.
A UI render or notification click cannot manufacture work completion.

goals.title: Run, steer, stop and recover a native dsh worker
goals.result: A real dsh task can be launched and redirected from Sophia, stopped correctly and recovered without losing its accepted goal.
steps: Boot the official profile in an isolated project container/home with outbound authenticated control and explicit readiness.
Bind public Agent create/resume and scoped setup to the command contract. Persist external correlation as a session extension event and reconcile it with native inbox/history.
Bridge durable session events separately from transient assistant chunks. Flush through the native checkpoint seam before durable-delivery receipts.
Implement Hold/Stop as domain fencing plus native cancellation and associated job settlement. Test role allowlists through ordinary tools and PTC.
acceptance: A live worker receives a mid-work steer at a supported boundary; later evidence distinguishes delivery from incorporation.
A controlled restart reconstructs command/native correlation and outstanding work.
A real Stop prevents new dispatch and candidate publication under the stopped epoch.
adverse_checks: Duplicate delivery does not repeat an admitted domain effect.
A late peer message cannot revive a stopped task.
A forbidden host tool remains forbidden inside a PTC program.
Hold retains pending context without permitting a native wake or goal driver to execute it before an explicit valid Resume.

goals.title: Build the shared Studio shell and real room transport
goals.result: Davide and Luis enter a real shared project, use independent lenses and hear one another while keeping one clear Sophia surface.
steps: Implement the custom React/Vite shell from the recovered Studio reference tokens and semantic map.
Implement current local lens/focus/drafts separately from shared project state. Preserve them during unrelated updates.
Issue scoped LiveKit room grants from the API; join from two independently authenticated clients.
Add explicit input-floor, invocation, end-exchange and room-leave controls; expose missing voice service honestly until S1-05.
acceptance: Changing Luis’s local view does not move Davide’s view or retask work.
Two actual participants can talk, see membership and pass the input role.
Required actions and persistent work controls remain accessible on narrow screens.
adverse_checks: Losing the UI connection does not cancel admitted background work.
An unauthorized participant cannot reuse a room token for a different project.

goals.title: Connect Gemini 3.8 Live to real work and selected vision
goals.result: Both founders converse with Gemini 3.8 Live, launch real asynchronous work and review a selected visual target without losing conversation or duplicating jobs.
steps: Implement raw RTC subscription/publishing and Google SDK connection with explicit audio format conversion and bounded buffers.
Bind each admitted utterance/tool request to the authenticated input-floor epoch. Settle the current exchange generation before switching speakers.
Configure tools as NON_BLOCKING and place scheduling/willContinue at the actual FunctionResponse top level. Return admitted job identity, not fictional completion.
Add selected-frame input, exact source lookups, Stop Looking, playback epoch suppression, GoAway/warm resume and cold context recovery.
acceptance: Each founder takes the floor and receives a coherent audible response; both hear the same Sophia.
A real dsh job continues while conversation continues, then yields one appropriate result notice.
Selected visual context and exact source identity agree.
A provider reconnect does not duplicate an admitted effect.
adverse_checks: Barge-in flushes old output; stale frames/audio are dropped.
Late tool results are not attributed to a new speaker.
Ending speech or observation does not stop an unrelated authorized build.

goals.title: Generate, compare and retain Google/OpenAI image assets
goals.result: The team generates actual image alternatives through both chosen vendors, selects an asset and reuses the same bytes in later source work.
steps: Implement the durable image-job lifecycle and private asset storage with source/consent provenance.
Implement Google Interactions generation/edit using response_format and model_output image parsing; store:false is explicit.
Implement OpenAI direct Images generation and multipart edit using the dated Sunburst snapshot. Make Google Pro and Flare selectable comparators.
Expose an intentional comparison and selection flow. Record actual request configuration, outcome, usage and human feedback without declaring a global winner.
acceptance: At least one real Google and one real OpenAI generation are stored and viewable.
An image edit uses the selected source image and produces a new candidate.
Selecting an image does not discard alternatives or trigger more paid generations.
adverse_checks: Refusal, no image output or timeout produces a truthful failed/uncertain result.
A retry after ambiguous acceptance is not blindly charged as another identical job.
Unrelated source edits preserve the selected asset reference.

goals.title: Produce runnable UI source that Luis can edit
goals.result: Sophia transforms the selected direction into a real interactive frontend, and Luis edits its source inside the workspace.
steps: Implement a supported React/TypeScript/Vite source bundle with retained tokens/assets and declared mock-to-real boundaries.
Use no-secret task containers for install/build/run; mount only the candidate workspace and limited result path.
Add Preview/Source/Diff using a bounded code editor, source version checks and explicit candidate rebuilding.
Compile the actual source, dependency lock, assets, behavior states and integration map into the handoff, rather than screenshots alone.
acceptance: The exported source builds in a fresh environment and matches the shown prototype.
Luis changes source and obtains a new preview without overwriting a newer accepted version.
Normal and failure/empty states have real local interaction and truthful simulation labels.
adverse_checks: Build failure leaves the last useful preview visible.
A user build script cannot access API/native login secrets or other project files.
A stack mismatch is recorded in the handoff, not hidden by a promise of zero rework.

goals.title: Import existing context and compile the next useful brief
goals.result: A project continues from selected ChatGPT/Claude material and source files; the next task uses current accepted decisions and relevant lessons.
steps: Implement selective import with an inclusion/omission preview and explicit project release; retain source provenance.
Separate accepted project records from imported advice/history and derived wiki pages.
Implement direct current-state reads, scoped source search/read and a bounded ContextPacket with exact revisions.
Implement correction/Forget influence fencing and one cycle-close learning that actually enters a later relevant brief.
acceptance: The team corrects an imported project summary before making it accepted context.
A next-session brief uses an earlier accepted decision or lesson with its source.
Private material remains excluded until its owner releases the exact contribution.
adverse_checks: An old model answer cannot override a newer project decision.
Revoked content cannot re-enter through a cached packet, offloaded page or resumed worker.
Missing export attachments are reported, not reconstructed as facts.

goals.title: Connect the three owner-operated engineering resources
goals.result: Davide’s Codex, Davide’s Claude Code and Luis’s Claude Code each perform real work and expose their actual status and owner-specific native requests.
steps: Complete the named Part 2 binding audit: exact current OpenAPI/session/feed/control/elicitation operations and owner authorization at the pinned Omnigent source.
Have each owner authorize launch/adoption of the selected native sessions and repo/worktree scope; keep vendor authentication native.
Implement capability-aware observations, amendment delivery and result collection through the narrow adapter.
Surface required native action with its exact resource/session/owner and reconcile resolution performed outside Sophia.
acceptance: All three actual resources are registered and each returns a useful bounded task result.
A real permission request appears for the correct owner and resolves from native evidence.
A locked but awake host does not require screenshot/click automation for supported programmatic operations.
adverse_checks: An edit grant does not permit arbitrary cross-owner host launch.
A sleeping/offline host is reported, not treated as still progressing.
Subscription or permission failure does not silently route through another person’s credentials.

goals.title: Enable goal-scoped peer messages and responsive handbacks
goals.result: A worker asks its coordinator a useful question during execution, gets an answer and continues without a human copying prompts or a lead model relaying each message.
steps: Implement the durable cross-runtime envelope and recipient assignment checks; native dsh peers use their existing team machinery.
Deliver through the actual native adapter boundary; wake an idle recipient through a supported command, not a perpetual model polling loop.
Track persisted, delivered, incorporated and acted-on states separately. Coalesce routine receipts and suppress acknowledgement-only exchanges.
Separate per-worker source areas and the shared deployment/database operation owner.
acceptance: A real Codex/Claude peer question and answer changes or confirms the ongoing approach before final completion.
A second Claude resource performs independent useful work or review under the same goal arrangement.
The technical lead sees relevant outcomes without paraphrasing each peer packet.
adverse_checks: Redelivered mail is deduplicated.
A stale assignment/epoch cannot receive new instructions.
Messages cannot expand permissions or race the designated shared-effect owner.

goals.title: Make the technical lead plan, review and steer the project
goals.result: Sophia proposes an actionable roadmap, allocates the available team and visibly reviews progress every five minutes or on request.
steps: Implement brief/roadmap/goal proposals and explicit acceptance with definitions of done.
Implement one coalesced active-project heartbeat plus event/manual triggers and a review lease.
Give the lead fresh bounded evidence, prior interventions and outstanding decisions; exclude known waits from automatic stagnation claims.
Implement continue, inspect, steer, fresh alignment, independent review, hold/replan and ask-human outcomes within the current mandate.
acceptance: Review work progress wakes the lead immediately and returns an evidence-linked decision.
One periodic review examines the project’s three resources without triple context duplication.
A meaningful change/preservation instruction reaches the proper goal coordinator/worker and is visible to the team.
adverse_checks: Two coincident triggers do not create duplicate lead turns.
A single ordinary test failure does not force a mission pivot.
A no-change review updates status without an unnecessary spoken interruption.

goals.title: Review and steer the complete application from Sophia
goals.result: The team opens a real integrated application, discusses an exact preview and sends a change/preserve brief to the engineering team.
steps: Bind the preview to source revision, environment and declared real/mocked services.
Implement separate Interact and Select-for-discussion modes with frame/target capture and exact source context.
Admit a clear authorized review intent; let the lead reconcile it with the current work and brief revision.
Show returned candidate, changed/preserved areas, tests and remaining uncertainty; retain the stable preview.
acceptance: A complete working application preview is usable inside the supported preview boundary.
An ambiguous target is clarified; an unambiguous authorized edit does not require redundant ceremony.
The team sees the actual worker amendment and checks its resulting candidate.
adverse_checks: A stale comment stays on the old preview unless deliberately retargeted.
An unembeddable external site gets an explicit supported review route rather than bypassed headers.
S1 does not label instruction-based preservation as guaranteed surgical editing.

goals.title: Deliver useful reports, PDFs and decks through isolated render jobs
goals.result: Sophia produces a meaningful sourced report and presentation, with retained images/source and actual usable exports.
steps: Finish the Part 2 renderer closure audit beginning at the verified legacy tool entry points; locate the real rich HTML-to-PDF and deck compilation functions and their dependencies.
Extract format-specific code into isolated jobs with explicit source inputs/results; replace ToolRuntime/thread path injection at the adapter boundary.
Integrate selected image assets and source manifests. Preserve source versus rasterized export distinctions.
Validate actual PDF/PPTX files and their visual rendering; register candidates through the ordinary artifact path.
acceptance: One substantive report and one deck are generated from retained source and readable in the app.
The files open correctly and include the intended images and sources.
The normal memory/authority route works; no special bypass admission is used.
adverse_checks: A renderer failure preserves prior output and returns diagnostic evidence.
The small legacy PDF smoke wrapper is not presented as a complete rich renderer.
An editable-source claim is not made for flattened raster output.

goals.title: Complete the founder project episode and release Sprint 1
goals.result: The first release is used end to end by both founders to create, coordinate, review and steer a real project.
steps: Run the actual episode from selected project import through voice/design/prototype, three-resource work, permission wait and integrated preview.
Exercise a manual/periodic review and one mid-work correction with explicit preservation.
Reconnect a UI and a provider connection; stop work with pending input; check the next-session context.
Publish the release unit, evidence, measured usage/latency, limitations and recovery instructions. Keep unmigrated legacy obligations assigned.
acceptance: Both humans and all three engineers contribute useful work on the intended path.
The native prototype source is integrated rather than recreated from a screenshot.
The application is reviewed from Sophia; the team knows what happened, what needs action and which version was checked.
A relevant accepted lesson appears in a later brief.
adverse_checks: No release claim depends on fixture-only account, media or deployment success.
Stop prevents stale publication/revival.
Known missing capability, uncertain cost or unresolved external effect remains visible.

goals.title: Semantic attention and milestone cooperation
goals.result: Use the heartbeat and actual artifact milestones to create source-bound opportunities; retain separate required actions, quiet progress and controls.

goals.title: Exact source-backed artifact revision
goals.result: Integrate expected-base and component-scoped mutations, preserved-sibling checks and atomic candidate publication for supported artifacts.

goals.title: Scenarios and executable application review
goals.result: Add Storybook/MSW scenario fixtures and Playwright assertions/traces; distinguish simulation, recorded replay and live application evidence.

goals.title: In-app native requests and mobile control
goals.result: Answer supported native permission requests from authenticated Sophia mobile/desktop; retain exact native handoff for unsupported login/OS actions.

goals.title: Consented discussion-following and richer voice
goals.result: Add per-track transcription, consented following, attributed context and a single speak/silent/card policy; test English, Italian and Spanish.

goals.title: Scoped project connectors and between-session continuity
goals.result: Add selected Notion, Supabase and Vercel management workflows, one notification channel and source-linked return briefs; existing engineer deployments remain usable.

goals.title: Authorized multi-week project continuity
goals.result: Continue dependent goals, reconcile unavailable hosts and uncertain effects, and preserve the mandate across idle periods and runtime restarts.

goals.title: A useful Sophia-native application implementer
goals.result: Deliver an actual end-to-end feature in the supported application stack using the same source, evidence, deployment and review contract as external engineers.

goals.title: Adaptive execution and procedure improvement
goals.result: Select and adjust approved model/effort/tool/team profiles from evidence; evaluate versioned procedure changes with rollback and current context eligibility.

goals.title: Repeated external-team use and clean migration
goals.result: Onboard a small team with a nontechnical contributor, observe repeated real work and willingness to pay, and retire old routes only after their obligations are discharged.

note: Product-release sprints, not a six-week commitment. Native session IDs are supplied by actual execution.
